summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The KraneShares 2x Long PDD Daily ETF (KPDD) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in consumer discretionary equity. The fund provides 2x leveraged exposure, less fees and expenses, to the daily price movement of PDD Holdings Inc. stock (ticker: PDD). KPDD was launched on Mar 11, 2025 and is issued by KraneShares.
